## Notes

- Methodology numbers below are reproducible from this committed bootstrap gold set (scripts/eval/run_resolution_eval.py). The write path is proven over real PG18+PostGIS in tests/db/test_resolution_materialize.py (append-only, idempotent +0).
- HOSTED SCALE (P30.2a, 2026-09-24, ADR-104): after the 14 camera-registry predicates were registered (and the camera_registry / connector_run genres joined the directness axis), the resolution materializer ran over the complete hosted spine as a Cloud Run job next to Cloud SQL (execution sig-materialize-c975g, 06:21:27Z -> 08:01:12Z, role sig_materialize): 1,955,508 (subject, predicate) groups considered, 1,872,344 envelopes now materialized (1,872,343 with a winning claim, 1 unresolved_conflict — the OKC claimed_device_count 299-vs-190, still kept visible); 83,164 groups on still-unregistered non-camera predicates skipped, not guessed (D-P30.2a-1).
- Camera-predicate envelopes: 1,872,336, every one uncontested (0 unresolved, 0 contradictions, 0 tolerance pools). This is expected and is NOT a quality signal: every hosted camera subject is ONE source's row (0 camera groups carry claims from more than one source), so each envelope adjudicates only that source's own claims — later re-captures supersede earlier ones (§28 Phase 1.4). 1,869,141 envelopes date their claims from the capture's retrieval time (labelled SIG-RECON-008:observed_at=capture_retrieved_at, ADR-104).
- WHAT THE NUMBERS MEAN: 230,330 of 230,330 observation-level camera sites carry a value-resolved coordinate — §28 VALUE resolution within each source's record. WHAT THEY DO NOT MEAN: they are not resolved/deduplicated sites. No record of one physical camera from different sources has been merged (entity merges = 0); the deduplicated-site count and dedup ratio are 'not measured' (n/a), not zero duplicates. Cross-source camera-site entity resolution is P30.2b; P30.3 must publish P30.2b's measured metric, never '230,330 resolved sites'.
- The methodology numbers above (kappa, floor, holdout P/R/F1) remain the PROVISIONAL LLM-bootstrap eval — the first-principles re-derivation against human ground truth is D-R6.1-EVAL's still-OPEN half.
